The best free background removers

Every background remover looks free until you download: some cap the size, some count exports, some need an account. Here is what you really get for free from three popular AI cut-out tools.

We make SlopIsolate, one of the tools on this page. Every fact about the other tools comes from their own pages, linked under each one, as they read on 2026-10-24. Prices and features change: check each site before you choose.

How we compared them

  • The free result: full size, no watermark, no export cap
  • Batches of many pictures, and video
  • Account and privacy: sign-up, and whether the picture leaves your device
  • Edit tools: refine brush, new background, blur

1. SlopIsolate (ours)

Best for: Full-size cut-outs of one picture or hundreds, free and on your own device, with no account.

Good

  • The AI runs in your browser; pictures are never uploaded
  • No limit on the number of images and no watermark
  • Keep and Remove brushes, edge softness and feather; transparent, colour, blur or image backgrounds, shadow and crop
  • Set the look once and apply it to the whole batch; PNG, WebP or JPG
  • Works on your phone, tablet and computer in the browser, even offline

Not so good

  • Still in beta
  • The first use downloads an AI model: about 4.4 MB for Fast, 44 MB for Quality or 25 MB for Portrait
  • Speed depends on your computer; videos should be short
  • No API

Open SlopIsolate

2. Photoroom

Best for: Product photos on a phone, with AI backgrounds and apps for iPhone, iPad and Android.

Good

  • No Photoroom watermark on free exports since August 2024
  • AI backgrounds, white background and a free background blur
  • Apps for iPhone, iPad and Android, plus a Shopify app and an API
  • Batch editing of thousands of pictures on paid plans

Not so good

  • Free exports are capped at 2000×2000 on the web and at 100 a month
  • Free accounts cannot be used for commercial purposes

Photoroom website · Sources: Photoroom background remover, Photoroom pricing, Photoroom help: export limit, Photoroom help: resolution limits, Photoroom help: commercial use, Photoroom blog, August 2024, Photoroom blur background, Photoroom API, Photoroom background remover tool, Photoroom help: web app, Photoroom security

3. Adobe Express

Best for: People who already have an Adobe account and want to drop the cut-out straight into a design.

Good

  • Free background removal with an Adobe account
  • Replace the background with a colour or a generated one
  • Works in desktop browsers and on phones, with iOS and Android apps
  • Part of a full design tool with templates

Not so good

  • Needs an Adobe account
  • One file at a time; batches only for enterprise
  • Video background removal is a Premium tool

Adobe Express website · Sources: Adobe Express remove background, Adobe Express pricing, Adobe Express home, Adobe Express help: Erase, Adobe Express blur background, Adobe Firefly Services: remove background API

Which one to choose

SlopIsolate is our pick: a full-size free result with no cap, batches and short videos, and no upload or account. You pay for it with a one-time model download and your own computer's time.

Choose Photoroom if you need AI product backgrounds, its native phone apps or an API, within its free caps and for non-commercial use. Choose Adobe Express if you already design in it and want the cut-out straight in a layout.

Questions

Which background remover is free at full resolution?

SlopIsolate saves the cut-out at the size of your original. Photoroom's free web exports are capped at 2000×2000. Adobe Express does not state its free result size.

Can I remove backgrounds from many photos at once for free?

Yes with SlopIsolate, with no limit on the number. Photoroom batches are on paid plans, and Adobe Express does one file at a time outside enterprise plans.

Are my photos uploaded?

Not with SlopIsolate: the AI model runs in your browser. Photoroom says its infrastructure runs in the United States; Adobe's pages we read do not say where processing happens.

Can I use the results commercially?

Photoroom says a free account cannot be used for commercial purposes. SlopIsolate sets no such rule on your pictures.
